gloss: to be on the defensive; to fall behind

definitions.gloss: to be on the defensive; to fall behind; to be reactive rather than proactive
definitions.explanation: To end up in a position where one can only react to events rather than control them. Originally from shogi/go terminology where 後手 means the second player (who moves second). Implies a disadvantageous position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{後手|ごて}に{回|まわ}った。
⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{後手|ごて}に{回|まわ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The government's measures were criticized for being reactive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{競合|きょうごう}→競合：05082_kyougou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}されて→越す：02282_kosu⟧{後手|ごて}に{回|まわ}らないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新商品|しんしょうひん}→新商品：11504_shinshouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投入|とうにゅう}→投入：12895_tounyuu⟧すべきだ。
examples.english: We should launch the new product early so we don't fall behind our competitors.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From board game terminology. In shogi and go, ⟦{後手|ごて}→後手：10557_gote⟧ refers to the player who moves second, which is generally considered a disadvantage. {後手|ごて}に{回|まわ}る means to be put into that second-mover position.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {後手|ごて}に{回|まわ}る vs. ⟦{先手|せんて}を{打|う}つ→先手を打つ：18391_sentewoutsu⟧: Opposite expressions. ⟦{先手|せんて}を{打|う}つ→先手を打つ：18391_sentewoutsu⟧ means to take the initiative, to make the first move — the proactive counterpart.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{後手|ごて}に{回|まわ}る (the response falls behind)
- ⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{後手|ごて}に{回|まわ}る (measures are reactive)
- {後手|ごて}に{回|まわ}らないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (so as not to fall behind)

USAGE:
Very common in news and business contexts when criticizing slow or reactive responses to problems, especially by organizations and governments.
